scope: Local source, locked configuration and existing anonymous qualification reports; no GPU job, server connection, endpoint read or source mutation by this reviewer

confirmed_training_contract.optimizer: Adam, learning rate 0.001; explicit actual L2 once per full-risk step
confirmed_training_contract.risk_set: Both GradCache passes iterate the same complete fit patient set; derivative computed from full-set Efron loss, never arbitrary microbatch Cox
confirmed_training_contract.stochastic_forward: All configured dropout is zero; fixed geometry and deterministic algorithms; every risk and component replay checked at absolute tolerance 1e-6
confirmed_training_contract.valid_outcomes: Not accessed by training or saved-model control generation
confirmed_training_contract.source_and_qualification_guard: Current source closure, interpreter prefix, exact qualification script hashes, official dependency files, original H5 catalogue size/mtime and source registry binding verified before a cell starts or resumes
confirmed_training_contract.native_H5_hash_limit: The start/resume guard binds the original complete-H5-SHA audit and checks live size/mtime/catalogue; it does not recompute every full H5 hash on every cell
confirmed_training_contract.completed_condition: DONE_PRIVATE.json exact identity and checkpoint SHA; a log, START, PROGRESS or LATEST is not completion

required_external_scheduler_controls.issue: The locked train_cell implementation does not implement a process lock; two simultaneous processes can both pass its non-atomic existence checks
required_external_scheduler_controls.control: One global scheduler flock plus one nonblocking flock per unique seed/fold/arm. The actual training child or exec wrapper must retain the cell lock for its entire lifetime, including if its scheduler exits. Do not inherit the global scheduler lock into children. Inspect existing process command lines before dispatch and never launch an already active cell.

required_external_scheduler_controls.issue: A failure before the first durable ten-epoch checkpoint leaves START but no resumable LATEST
required_external_scheduler_controls.control: Do not automatically treat that directory as a fresh cell, delete it or hide wasted optimizer steps. Mark blocked, preserve the failed attempt and diagnose after confirming the process is dead. Any explicit same-initialization recovery must retain original artifacts and account for wasted work.

required_external_scheduler_controls.issue: After epoch 10, a failure can leave PROGRESS ahead of the last atomically replaced LATEST
required_external_scheduler_controls.control: Resume only from the exact cell's valid same-source LATEST. Verify its epoch/history against that cell's START, preserve optimizer state and record the replayed epoch interval. Do not copy another arm's optimizer checkpoint; initial tensor hashes can be shared across arms.

required_external_scheduler_controls.issue: Cell wall_seconds restarts at every resumed train_cell invocation
required_external_scheduler_controls.control: Keep append-only per-attempt start/end times, exit code, durable checkpoint epoch and most recent progress epoch; cumulative wall time and actual executed optimizer work must be reported separately from the 80-step completed model.

required_external_scheduler_controls.issue: Qualification payloads are compared for exact equality across a same-source resume
required_external_scheduler_controls.control: Do not edit INPUT_AUDIT, NUMERICAL_QUALIFICATION or DEPENDENCY_QUALIFICATION during formal execution. Append execution state to separate new reports. Do not change the source closure, preprocessing, schedule, readout or cache policy to improve throughput.

recovery_state_table.state: Active process or held cell lock
No START and no active process
recovery_state_table.action: Fresh fixed cell may launch after all guards

recovery_state_table.state: START, no DONE, same-source valid LATEST, no active process
recovery_state_table.action: Explicit --resume only, with recorded attempt and checkpoint epoch

recovery_state_table.state: START, no DONE, no durable LATEST
recovery_state_table.action: Block and diagnose; no automatic restart

recovery_state_table.state: LATEST at epoch 80 but no DONE
recovery_state_table.action: Resume skips training loop and regenerates saved prediction/control outputs; the existing checkpoint without DONE remains incomplete

recovery_state_table.state: Corrupt checkpoint, conflicting identity, changed qualifications or source
recovery_state_table.action: Fail closed; no substitution or automatic fresh restart

resource_and_io_findings.CPU_memory_limit: The exact tensors and bounded LRU exclude transient alignment/standardization arrays, imported libraries, spatial plan Python objects, prediction banks, OS cache and CUDA host buffers; measure RSS and system available memory
resource_and_io_findings.CUDA_memory_limit: Previously qualified 1.65 GiB three-input peak is not an upper bound for all patients, arms or concurrent processes
resource_and_io_findings.H5_access: Four-slide LRU is much smaller than a complete fit sweep; the next full pass starts at the beginning, so cross-pass cache reuse can be close to zero
resource_and_io_findings.engineering_io_order_estimate: For about 327 fit patients, 80 epochs and two sweeps, roughly 52,000 patient-level H5 visits per cell before multi-WSI correction; extrapolating selected H5 row volume gives tens of TB of logical array reads over 30 cells. This is not a measured physical disk read count or a runtime promise; OS page cache and HDF5 layout matter
resource_and_io_findings.disk_outputs: About 3.4 MiB of float32 model parameters per cell; optimizer-state resumable checkpoints are several times larger. Keep final checkpoint and latest optimizer state until independent replay. No new raw feature disk cache is allowed by this lock
resource_and_io_findings.concurrency_plan: Start one actual formal cell through at least one complete epoch, then add concurrency in controlled steps such as two and four. Keep data, batch, schedule and model unchanged. Measure epoch throughput, aggregate GPU utilization/memory, per-process RSS/CPU, system memory available, physical I/O and iowait. Reduce concurrency if aggregate throughput worsens or memory headroom disappears
resource_and_io_findings.quiet_monitoring: Collect compact process/resource status while ordinary execution is unchanged. Do not infer failure from a stale progress timestamp during an expensive epoch; distinguish active CPU/H5 work, GPU activity, process exit and durable checkpoint state

advantages: Per-cell atomic checkpoints and source/qualification guards support exact-identity recovery
Complete-risk Efron and saved independent replay separate training from held-out outcome evaluation
limitations: Duplicate dispatch is not prevented by train_cell itself
No durable recovery point exists before epoch 10
CPU/HDF5 throughput and operating-system cache may limit useful parallelism before CUDA memory is exhausted
assessment.confidence: High for the reviewed source control flow and exact tensor byte counts; concurrency speedup, physical I/O and full-matrix duration require live measurements
